info.title: account (Account API)
info.description: The account API provides information on users, user accounts, user profiles, and user account attributes.

scopes.co-auth-all.read: With this scope you can read all auth resources.
scopes.co-auth-all.write: With this scope you can write all auth resources

AccountStatus.description:
Enum representing the status of an account.

* **OK**: Account is in good standing.
* **GESPERRT**: Account is locked.
* **BEENDET**: Account is terminated.
* **FRAGLICH**: Account status is questionable.
* **VERBOTEN**: Account is forbidden.
* **INAKTIV**: Account is inactive.

AccountTypeAttributeResource.description: An account type attribute is a key-value pair that is assigned to an account type.The key consists of a service key and an attribute key. The value is the actual value of the attribute.

serviceKey.description: The key of the associated service.

attributeKey.description: The key of the attribute. Only unique within the serviceKey.

accountTypeKey.description: The key of the associated account type.

AccountTypeResource.description: Account types categorize the different accounts of a user. For example, a person who has both the roles of student and staff may have two different accounts for CAMPUSonline. However, due to the separation of profile roles and account types, this is not necessarily the case. A person with multiple profile roles can also have just one account.

key.description: The unique human readable key for an account type.

name.description: The human-readable name of an account type in different languages.

diagnosticContext.description: Contains error-specific values that place the general error message in a specific context (e.g. listing a specific course number).

I18nValueResource.description: Used for multilingual texts. It consists of a map where the key is Language.key from the Language enum and the value is the text in the corresponding language.

UserAccountResource.description:
A valid user account allows the user to log in to CAMPUSonline.
A person can have multiple user accounts of different account types.
A user account is also associated with multiple attributes.

personUid.description: Unique identifier for the person associated with the account.

accountTypeKey.description: Key representing the type of the account.

externalIdentityId.description: External identity identifier associated with the account.

email.description: Email address associated with the account.

Scopes: [co-account.read]
The user account attributes are associated with the user account and can be used to store additional information about the user account.

parameters.description: Parameter used to navigate through the pages of the current QueryPageResource. To move to the next page, the value of this parameter should be the ‘nextCursor' field from the previous QueryPageResource. If there are no more pages, ‘nextCursor’ will be empty. Note: When the ‘offset’ or ‘sort’ parameters are used, no ‘nextCursor’ will be calculated, as offset-based paging is used instead of cursor-based paging.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return per page and is essential for controlling pagination size.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The starting index for the page of results. If not specified, defaults to the beginning. Using this parameter disables cursor pagination.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Only return user account attributes that are associated with the service with the service_key.
parameters.name: service_key

parameters.description: Allows for sophisticated sorting of query results. It's structured as a comma-separated list, where each element specifies a field to sort by, optionally prefixed with a + or - to denote an ascending or descending order, respectively. By default, sorting is done in ascending order if no prefix is used. Additionally, the handling of null values can be customised by appending -nl (Nulls Last) or -nf (Nulls First) to each field.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Only return user account attributes that have the provided values.
parameters.name: values

200.description: A paginated list of user account attributes.

post.summary: An endpoint for retrieving or searching through all account resources of natural persons. For security reasons, even though this operation is read-only, it is implemented as a POST endpoint. This ensures that the username is never passed as a query parameter, preventing it from appearing in access logs.

tags.name: Account Attributes
tags.description: Account are associated with attributes.The attributes can be used to store additional information about the account.

tags.name: Account Types
tags.description: A user can have multiple accounts of different account-types.The account-types can be created and changed via configuration. Currently, the account types are derived from the "benutzergruppen" table, which is also used to manage different profile roles in CAMPUSonline.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: A user is a natural person who owns one or more accounts of different account types in CAMPUSonline. This endpoint provides the ability to list all users of the system and search through their account data.
